ABOUT

JunYoungJo.

Software developer

My background is in C++ and Qt desktop development. More recently, I have been building apps and developer tools with Rust, Tauri, React, and TypeScript.

My professional work involves data processing, analysis, and desktop tools. My personal interests include systems programming, code analysis, and building better ways to work with AI agents.

AI-ASSISTED DEVELOPMENT

Developing with AI

I use Claude Code and Codex for design, implementation, tests, and review. I also experiment with splitting work between agents and cross-reviewing results with different models.

01

Design and implementation

Review the existing code and requirements, break the work into tasks, and implement with coding agents.

02

Tests and review

Use AI for tests and code review as well as implementation. Compare perspectives from different models and assess the results.

03

Context and tooling

Build tools for recurring needs such as session analysis, task management, and retaining project context.
